subject: Data Engineering
title: The Business Glossary
description: A quick win: understand The Business Glossary.

hook.text: Marketing defines 'active user' as logged in this month. Product defines it as completed an action this week.

buildup.text: A business glossary defines standard terms so every team uses the same language for the same concept.

discovery.text: Glossary entries include the term, its definition, the owner, and which datasets use it.

twist.text: Building the glossary is easy. Getting teams to actually agree on definitions is the political challenge.

climax.text: A shared glossary linked to the data catalog ensures definitions and data stay connected.

punchline.text: Same word, same meaning. Across every team.

quiz.question: What problem does a business glossary solve?
options: Different teams using different definitions for the same term
